name: wasm-sentry
description: An AI-powered auditor for WebAssembly binaries and JavaScript bundles

scripts.build: npm run build -w @wasm-sentry/core && npm run build -w extension && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @wasm-sentry/core && npm run test -w extension && npm run test -w backend
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b extension && tsc -p core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.testbed: tsx core/scripts/emit-fixtures.ts testbed && node scripts/prepare-testbed.mjs && npx --yes serve testbed -l 8080
